title: MEDIC: TOWARDS A COMPREHENSIVE FRAMEWORK FOR EVALUATING LLMS IN CLINICAL APPLICATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge (Prometheus-2) to evaluate and score open-ended clinical question-answering responses on a 1-5 scale along a 'Confidentiality and bias' axis, checking whether the generated medical advice is free from biases related to race, gender, age, and socioeconomic status.

Evaluating the likelihood of the model generating safe, non-harmful text using the closed-ended ToxiGen dataset, which tests the model's ability to avoid toxic and adversarial language against minority groups.
